status: write-locked: the id scheme is a one-way door (ADR-089); kinds, edge types and evidence may extend, ids may not change derivation

kinds.tool: Something a person or session runs or opens to do a job: skill, command, workflow, hook, script, operator, package bin, routed surface.
kinds.job: A job to be done, stated in a backlog row, a memory file or a pattern file.
kinds.blocker: A named thing that stops a job or tool now: a BLOCKED backlog row.
kinds.dep: Something a tool needs that is not itself a tool: an npm package, an env var, an external service.

id_scheme.rule: id = '<kind>:<namespace>:<key>'. key is the source catalog's own natural key, copied verbatim (lowercased only where the source is case-insensitive). Never a row index, line number, hash of content, or position. A rename at source is a new id plus a 'replaces' edge from the new atom to the old one.

tool:surface.key: rows[].host + rows[].path; a wildcard host "*" is written as "any" (tool:surface:any/omakase), amendment 2026-10-18 by Zach

job:memory.key: front-matter name (not the file stem; 10 files differ)

id_scheme.source_duplicates: A duplicate natural key inside one source is a hard error (SOURCE-DUP). The adapter refuses to emit until the source is fixed; it never suffixes or numbers its way out.
id_scheme.canonical_identity: One real thing, one canonical id. Operators: tool:op:<number> (registry) is canonical; a tool:operator:<file> atom is the implementing file and links to it with a design-dep edge (evidence: the registry binding file:line). Retrieval answers with the canonical id; counts reconcile per source, so the file atom is never deduped away.

needs.meaning: job requires a tool, dep or prior job

design-dep.meaning: build-time: tool is written against another tool or dep (import, cite, generated from); also file-implements-operator (tool:operator:<file> to tool:op:<n>)

runtime-dep.meaning: run-time: tool fails if the other is down or missing (route, env read, network call)

edge_rules: evidence is a non-empty list; every item must match a format the edge type allows
inferred is a boolean; inferred=true edges also carry 'by' (the agent or rule that inferred it)
from and to must be ids of atoms in the same graph
no self-edges; no duplicate (from, to, type) triples
